h:
我只是想分享一个我为 Flux 制作的工作流程，使用一个和/或两个高分辨率图像的放大器。我在工作流程本身中写了解释性注释。

您可能需要安装自定义节点，只需跳上管理器并安装它们即可！

o.en:
I just thought I'd share a workflow I made for Flux using one and/or two upscalers for high res images. I wrote explanatory notes in the workflow itself.

You might need to install custom nodes, just hop on the manager and install them!
